rules: The package declaration is mandatory before development begins.
Each internal phase declares all seven fields; inheritance may narrow but never omit or widen.
Authorized Files/Modules are an allowlist, not examples.
Explicit Out-of-Scope must name protected shared foundation and prohibited data/access surfaces.
Validation Profile must map Definition -> Contract -> Branch -> Development -> Diff check -> Fixture -> Integration -> optional Smoke -> Exact-head corpus -> PR -> Squash merge -> integration.
Any material change to one of the seven fields requires a new Human Decision before execution continues.
Result R55 must report declared versus actual scope and every deviation.

architecture_alignment.hierarchy: KU2 Platform -> KU2D Acquisition -> Foundation -> Domain / Techniques / Contracts -> Source Adapter -> Generic Runner -> Run Manifest -> Quality Gates -> Evidence
architecture_alignment.invariant_rule: All invariant files must remain byte-identical. If not possible, stop with a foundation blocker.

access_and_request_policy.raw_payload_storage: minimum sanitized fixture only; no secrets, tokens, cookies, request URLs or unnecessary personal data

minimum_trusted_connection: at least one useful reproducible capability for each topic or an explicit external blocker
schema-valid source/domain records with provenance and timestamp
known access limitations and failure modes
sanitized fixture replay through unchanged Generic Runner
Analysis-ready output without semantic quality claims

instructions: Validate the P54 package declaration before development and persist a seven-field declaration for each internal phase.
Inspect Technique Library and P53 contracts before attempting TikTok access.
Explore only authorized public surfaces in strategy order and within the 20-request ledger.
Do not assume YouTube-equivalent fields; declare actual TikTok capabilities and limitations.
After evidence is obtained, sanitize once and use fixture replay for all further tests.
Add TikTok only through authorized extension modules; do not modify any invariant file.
Acquisition retains every technically valid bounded record and does not rank relevance or decide final inclusion.
Run targeted tests, Level 2 validations and one exact-head full corpus; merge one green PR and verify the final tree.
Submit only KU2D-R-000055 with all seven declarations, declared-versus-actual diff, access attempts, records by topic, MTC/blocker, CJ4, tests, PR/CI/tree, request/quota and limitations.
stop_conditions: any Phase/Package declaration is missing, invalid, contradictory or requires broader authority
login, cookies, credentials, provider approval, CAPTCHA/anti-bot or policy bypass is required
more than 20 requests or any spending/quota is required
an invariant foundation or CI workflow file must change
production write, scheduling, main modification or elevated authority is required
definition_of_done: P54 and every internal phase have validated seven-field declarations
the durable Scope Declaration v1 contract is reusable by future Prompts
Explore/Deep Audit address both topics within policy
TikTok capabilities and limitations are explicit
source is added through adapter/manifests/registry/fixtures without invariant changes
fixture replay passes unchanged runner and technical gate
at least one valid record per topic reaches Analysis or genuine external blocker is proven
one green PR squash-merges when evidence exists
requests/quota and declared-versus-actual scope are exact
